title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
syn: A time ripple damages the Enterprise, forcing young and old Uhura to cooperate and fix the timeline.
syn_fr: Une faille temporelle endommage l'Enterprise, forçant la jeune et la vieille Uhura à coopérer pour rétablir le cours du temps.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered
syn: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is the third installment in the series of games developed by CD PROJEKT RED featuring the witcher Geralt of Rivia. The game was originally scheduled for release in late 2014, then pushed back to 24 February 2015, and finally released on 19 May 2015. During the first two weeks since release it had sold more than 4 million copies worldwide, more than doubling the total sales…

title: Avatar: Seven Havens
syn: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

title: VisionQuest
syn: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.
syn_fr: Vision, réinitialisé après avoir échappé à ceux qui cherchaient à l’utiliser comme une arme, vit désormais caché. En quête de sens, il se tourne vers les personnalités d’IA intégrées à sa programmation, parmi lesquelles Friday, Edith, Jarvis et le redoutable Ultron. Mais sa vie discrète prend fin lorsqu’une prime est mise sur sa tête, le contraignant à fuir aux côtés de Thomas Shepard, un garçon mystérieux qui pourrait être la réincarnation de son fils. Pour échapper à ceux qui le traquent, Vision doit affronter sa véritable nature, résister à l’influence d’Ultron et percer le mystère qui entoure son jeune compagnon s’il veut survivre.

title: Clayface
syn: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
syn_fr: L'ascension fulgurante de Matt Hagen, de gamin des rues de Gotham à star hollywoodienne, est brutalement interrompue lorsqu'un baron du crime le laisse atrocement défiguré. Abandonné de tous et n'ayant plus rien à perdre, Matt se tourne vers un traitement expérimental qui lui rend miraculeusement son apparence... mais altère profondément sa perception de la réalité. Il sombre alors dans une spirale destructrice, consumé par un irrépressible désir de vengeance.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
syn: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
syn_fr: Les Avengers, les Wakandais, les Quatre Fantastiques, les New Avengers et les X-Men, tous héros issus de trois univers distincts se retrouvent sur une trajectoire de collision mortelle et font face à une menace existentielle sans précédent, comme ils n'en ont jamais rencontré auparavant, le Docteur Doom.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
syn: An original story set approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
syn: Hunted by Miguel O'Hara's Spider Society and betrayed by his friends, Miles finds himself in the darkest corners of the Spider-Verse in search of a way home. Knowing that his family has been not only fractured but endangered by his calling, it's a race against the clock for Miles to travel across the wildest reaches of time and space to fight for and reunite everything he holds most dear.

title: Man of Tomorrow
syn: Superman and Lex Luthor find themselves forced to work together—to a certain degree—against a much, much bigger threat when Brainiac sets his sights on Earth.
